risks: Critical: remux/rename before metadata commit can lose audio association on crash; no-part branch returns success-ready and audio null.
Critical: failedChunks is counted only in renderer memory and ignored; unplug is indistinguishable from ordinary stop; current source cannot satisfy never silently ready for loss.
Current native server journal completion is intent-only and empty-outbox, not finalized audio/Whisper evidence; using it as migrated media-ready would fabricate capability.
Current shared-like native handlers accept client actor/grant and ignore authenticated transport context; there is no trusted principal proof in those inspected handlers.
Actual local UI consumer pages/MeetingsPage.tsx is outside the normative affectedFiles list; patching only meetings/MeetingsWorkspace.tsx misses local error/control/search integration.
Two proposed migration identifiers and repeated calls-domain new paths can collide with lead/other packages; root must retain one integration owner.
Local import 2 GiB vs native intent 512 MiB; migration must not shrink existing local capability or discard oversize local audio when shared publish is refused.
Local IDs are m-* strings, not UUIDs; alias migration must preserve these real IDs despite normative filesystem UUID phrase.
normalizeMeeting silently forces current schema and ready for unknown status; adding fields without reader/model/consumer migration loses evidence.
ffmpeg false-remux fallback can preserve bytes but does not validate codec/playability; current tests use arbitrary bytes and cannot prove media readiness.

Local readAudio materializes entire file and detail builds a Blob; preserve existing behavior without introducing additional full-file copies for hashing/publication (use streamed file hash/transfer through accepted artifact pipeline).
ASR run has no timeout in source; specification prose must not be accepted as implemented timeout evidence. Runtime hung-process behavior remains unverified.

safe agent session is not a guarantee that transcript stays offline: summary prompt is sent to configured agent backend; summary availability and privacy/execution policy remain separate from audio-upload consent.

Generic integration test wording includes offline summary but explicit goal/acceptance denies that existing capability; lead must correct the oracle, not invent offline model success or weaken unavailable-state criterion.
Search/mentions/notifications/activity/sharing/API/MCP obligations remain missing until common integrations provide actual receipts; no N/A issued for unimplemented behavior.

All observations are static preflight evidence only; installed binary/model, OS permission, live media, network zero-send and kill/relaunch behavior were intentionally not exercised. Root integration can stale any referenced source hash.
